title: Project config (project.yml)
description: Machine-readable config for a lead workspace or an active project. The `stage` field discriminates the two. Credentials must never appear here — see docs/baseline-system.md (Privacy).

schema_version.description: Schema major version this document targets. Bumped only on breaking changes.

slug.description: Lowercase, dashes only. Matches bin/rename-theme.sh's slug rule.

source_path.description: Human-facing path to the futurebase checkout used. Not machine-authoritative.

template_commit.description: Commit the CREATED project repo was generated from (template provenance), not merely local futurebase HEAD.

synced_commit.description: Starter commit this project was last reconciled with by `futurebase sync`. Unlike template_commit this is always accurate, being stamped by the command that did the work.

promoted_to.description: For a promoted lead: the remote repo the lead became (e.g. kicobi/acme-client).

modules.description: Which baseline modules are in scope. Keys: public, wordpress, hosting, analytics, manual.

allow_credentials_in_project.description: Must be false. Enforced by review + a future secret scanner; the schema alone cannot guarantee no secrets leak into free text.

preset.description: Preset slug from tools/project-system/presets/. Influences enabled modules and metric suggestions.
